ceiling_directive: Extend the posterior-fiber characterization and endpoint compiler to the published Equation 7 SCM class by allowing arbitrary within-time coupling of policy-action and stochastic-reward response variables, thereby removing the published counterfactual-independence assumption in full rather than only for transition rows.
improvement_directive: Jointly parameterize transition, policy-action, and reward response couplings under factual-trajectory abduction, then reprove attained shared endpoints and the constrained-width compiler over that enlarged fiber.
critique: The note proves an attained sharp interval for a conditional-mean trajectory Shapley coordinate by varying only within-time transition response-row coupling, with deterministic known rewards, externally randomized policy actions, and independent time blocks. The public Li–Lee–Bareinboim Equation 7 and Assumption 3.3 formulation also imposes counterfactual-independence structure on action potential outcomes and treats transition/reward simulation jointly, while this note expressly excludes policy-response and reward-noise coupling; it therefore establishes an analogue on a narrower SCM class, not full removal of the published assumption. Its exact endpoint compiler is polynomial in the horizon only for fixed alphabets with O(log H) active factual stages; the fully stochastic class retains exponential constrained width, so this is not a general efficient solution. The TL;DR phrase "once counterfactual independence across action rows is removed" is accurate only if "action rows" means transition rows; read as referring to the published Assumption 3.3, it over-claims. No theorem-level conjecture remains inside the stated restricted class, so the floor shortfall is the class transfer rather than an unproved displayed endpoint.
